title: Share of an Expedited Fee Returned by Cause of Failure (Home Delivery Pharmacy Service Guarantee)
content:
## Service guarantee schedule: share returned by cause

**Schedule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy expedited shipment that was replaced, the share of the booked fee returned depends on why the shipment was replaced: half when it arrived damaged, because a damaged package still arrived on the promised day, three quarters when it arrived temperature-compromised, and all of it when it was lost in transit.

The cause is the replacement reason recorded on the replacement shipment, and the share is a share of the expedited fee booked on the replaced order.

### Share by replacement reason

| Replacement reason recorded | Share of the booked fee returned |
|---|---|
| Damaged | half (0.5) |
| Temperature excursion (arrived temperature-compromised) | three quarters (0.75) |
| Lost in transit | all of it |

### Hypothetical illustrations (booked fee of 24.95)

- Replaced because damaged: half of 24.95, 12.475 before the final rounding to the cent.
- Replaced because temperature-compromised: three quarters of 24.95, 18.7125 before the final rounding.
- Replaced because lost in transit: all of 24.95.

### Basis of the damaged share

The damaged share is half because a damaged package still arrived on the promised day.
